title: From Zero
projectContext: Final exhibition at Entrance Space before its move to a new space; framed in relation to the venue's opening exhibition 《八戒》.
projectContextZh: 入口空间搬迁至新址前的最后一场展览，并与该空间的开幕展《八戒》形成首尾呼应。

format: Exhibition / AI-generated conceptual art system / participatory prompt interface / installation documentation
formatZh: 展览 / AI 生成的观念艺术系统 / 参与式提示词界面 / 装置文献
operativeMedium: AI prompt system, conceptual-art language generator, exhibition computer interface, generated artwork proposals
operativeMediumZh: AI 提示词系统、观念艺术语言生成器、展览电脑界面、生成式作品方案
publicInterface: exhibition, wall text, visitor prompt interface, AI-generated image/work documentation, WeChat review link
publicInterfaceZh: 展览、墙面文字、观众提示词界面、AI 生成图像与作品文献、微信回顾链接
systemBehaviour: the prompt interface exposes conceptual art as a language-and-authorization machine; visitors can run the grammar themselves and watch authorship shift from making to rule-setting, selection, and naming
systemBehaviourZh: 提示词界面将观念艺术暴露为一台语言与授权机器；观众可以亲自运行这套语法，并观察作者性如何从制作转移到规则设定、筛选与命名
summaryEn: An exhibition and participatory prompt system using AI to test conceptual art's dependence on language, authorship, institutional authorization and the repeatable grammar of contemporary-art legitimacy.
summaryZh: 《从零开始》并不是一场炫技式的 AI 图像展，而是借 AI 把观念艺术的语言机制、作者性和授权链条拆开给观众看。观众通过系统生成观念艺术文本并制作自己的作品，亲手跑一遍这套“作品如何成立”的语法。
englishContext:
From Zero / 从零开始 used AI to put conceptual art under pressure from inside its own grammar. The exhibition began from a blunt historical question: if twentieth-century conceptual art made language, instruction and idea into the core of the work, what happens when language itself can be generated by a model? In the project, AI was not treated as a spectacle of image production, but as a machine for producing proposals, prompts, documentation and plausible artistic logic.

Presented at Entrance Space in Zhengzhou from November 2025 to January 2026, the exhibition invited visitors to generate conceptual-art texts and produce their own works through the system. Its joke was not simply that AI could make art, but that many parts of contemporary art already operate through repeatable phrases, authorizing contexts and institutional permission. By opening that machinery to visitors, From Zero asked where authorship now sits: in the idea, the prompt, the selection, the signature, or the chain of power that decides something may enter an art narrative.
fullTextZh:
正式策展文本

自摄影术将“再现”从绘画中剥离，艺术一次次被技术革命逼至自我定义的边缘。从杜尚的《泉》到索尔·勒维特、劳伦斯·韦纳等人所发展的观念艺术，20世纪艺术逐渐确立“观念即作品”的逻辑——艺术的物质性与手工性被不断削弱，转而让位于思想与语言的生成。由此，一切都可以成为“观念艺术”，生产观念的指令性语言构成了艺术家作者性的根基。那么，当语言本身已被大模型掌握，“观念艺术”是否仍然需要一个作者？“观念”是否仍然源于人的意识？

人工智能的全面降临让艺术又一次处在需要“自我定义”的历史性时刻。对于观念艺术而言，在“观念”生成的那一刻，作品便已完成；我们所看到的“作品”，事实上只是这一过程的档案（documentation）。AI 天然就是一个观念生产机器：它接受文字指令（Prompt），提出问题，并给出视觉化转换的执行方案。这几乎从逻辑上完成了观念艺术的自我消解——它证明了观念可以被自动生成、执行，并可能达到形式上的完美。 在杜尚的时代，现成品（ready-made） 尚需艺术家选择、命名、签名；在 AI 时代，现成品（ready-made）的选择、变形、再语义化都可以程序化地由 AI 来完成。而使用 AI 的艺术家们正在从“创作”变为“策展”，人成为了 AI 的“手”。

作为入口空间在搬离新空间前的最后一个展览，《从零开始》与其开幕展览《八戒》形成了清晰的首尾呼应：它们分别从两个时刻发问：“艺术是什么？什么还能是艺术？”

这并非一场炫技式的AI图像秀，而是关于AI如何暴露并解构了观念艺术的程序性。它或许是一次“行为艺术”，或许是一个“算法剧场”，但更准确地说，它是一次对当代观念艺术创作方法论的质询。没有艺术家、没有精心放置的作品、没有策展叙事中的隐喻花火，只有一台电脑，一个 AI 模型，几组prompt。我们邀请观众用系统共同生成观念艺术文本，并制作自己的观念艺术作品。

如今，我们正站在一个旧范式的尽头，或许也是新范式的起点。从零开始，不是回到原点，而是承认原点早已被新的篇章覆盖。

策展人：Lianyi Wang

展览回顾文案

《从零开始》算是一个脑洞的产物。很多人以为它在讨论 AI，或是在宣判观念艺术已死；但与其说在探讨这些问题，不如说是借了AI这个噱头，去触碰艺术创作里更底层的两样东西：语言与权力。

首当其冲的是语言的有效性。观念艺术常常在玩弄语言，当“观念”本身被大家默认成为作品主体，事情就变得有趣了：这个拙劣的生成器等于把那套主体的常见语法抽了出来，公开演示它是如何运作的。那么它所生产的“艺术”，究竟是在传递某种思想，还是在执行一种只在艺术语境里才成立的“合法化仪式”？观众能否借它理解、生成或反驳那些套路化的观念作品？艺术家自己又是否有能力在这套语法之外说话？

其次是谁有权定义什么是艺术？当观念可以被AI自动生成，这个过程反而揭露了作者性的转移：从简单的“我想到，所以我创造”，转移为“我如何设定规则、筛选想法、并为结果署名”。公众所能看到的艺术，往往发生在一条相似的授权链条里。谁有权把一个方案标为作品，谁有权让它被看见、被收藏、被写进叙事，谁就更接近于定义“艺术是什么”。到头来，这可能是个身份问题。

更隐秘的一层，是当代艺术的生产关系与剥削结构。在许多大艺术家工作室里，确实存在一种苦力式的集体创作，最后由大艺术家署名的“创作”机制。某种意义上，那也算一种简化版的大数据碰撞。生成器则把这种模式进行了极端化呈现：当“集思广益”被 AI 替换时，对艺术生产链条下位者的剥削会不会减少？还是只会以更隐形、更结构化的方式转移？

把这三条合在一起，《从零开始》更像是一次对“当代艺术作为语言游戏”的压力测试。我试图打开创作的黑箱，让观众亲手跑一遍这套语法与授权机制，看看它是否还能产生真实的理解与连接，但样本数量太少，我并不确定它有没有成功。

稀缺的手艺、独特的灵光、不可复制的审美产物，当然可以是艺术；对条件、机制与话语权的揭示，也可以是艺术。而在我看来，当代艺术最敏感的那根神经恰恰在这里：“艺术家们”长期倚重的那套话语，原来可以被任何人、任何机器批量生成，并且在形式上看起来成立。当然，由于只是看起来像，没有被写进艺术叙事的权力链条里，也就不存在什么真正意义上的威胁了。

title: Seeing the Balsam Flowers as a Farewell to Precepts
chineseTitle: 看见凤仙花是一种还俗行为
projectContext: Chen Li's first solo exhibition in Singapore, presenting painting and installation works developed around the balsam flower.
projectContextZh: 陈俐在新加坡的首次个展，呈现其围绕凤仙花展开的绘画与装置创作。
operativeMedium: mineral-pigment painting and ritual-like sculptural installation organised around the balsam flower
operativeMediumZh: 围绕凤仙花展开的矿物颜料绘画与仪式性雕塑装置
publicInterface: solo exhibition in a commercial gallery
researchFields: desire, stigma and the loss of speech
systemBehaviour: a familiar flower moves between childhood cosmetic practice, rural memory and a ritual image that refuses the demand for female purity
systemBehaviourZh: 一朵熟悉的乡野花，在童年染甲、农村记忆与仪式图像之间移动，并拒绝女性必须纯洁和自我献祭的要求
summaryEn: Chen Li's first solo exhibition in Singapore, centred on balsam flowers, rural femininity, cultural identity and the aesthetics of Oriental mysticism.
summaryZh: 《看见凤仙花是一种还俗行为》从陈俐童年用凤仙花染指甲的经验出发，将乡村女性的欲望、地方仪式与被迫神圣化的女性形象并置。绘画与神龛式装置让凤仙花在祛魅和复魅之间摇摆，并把“还俗”指向对清规戒律和自我牺牲的拒绝。
englishContext:
JW PROJECTS presented Chen Li's first solo exhibition in Singapore from 27 April to 9 June 2024. The exhibition brought together paintings and installations developed over more than a year around the balsam flower, using it to approach contemporary narratives of femininity, cultural identity and the aesthetics of Oriental mysticism.

Common but resilient, the balsam flower grows in poor soil and remains closely tied to Chen's childhood in rural Zhejiang, where ancestor worship, folklore and collective ritual shaped everyday life. The childhood practice of dyeing fingernails with balsam flowers became the exhibition's narrative starting point.

Mineral pigments, shrines, snails, candles and feathers move between demystification and remystification. The exhibition refuses the familiar demand that women become pure, selfless symbols: seeing the balsam flowers becomes an act of leaving the altar, returning to ordinary life and recovering an individual self.
fullTextZh:
JW PROJECTS荣幸地宣布，将于2024年4月27日至6月9日推出青年艺术家陈俐在新加坡的首次个展《看见凤仙花是一种还俗行为》。该展览将呈现陈俐一年多来围绕凤仙花进行的一系列架上及装置创作，阶段性展示陈俐对当代语境下的女性叙事、文化身份与东方神秘主义美学的探索。

凤仙花是一种乡野间十分常见的植物，它并不名贵，却有着旺盛的生命力，在贫瘠的土壤中也可以肆意生长。陈俐的童年在浙江的农村度过，成长环境中的祖先崇拜、民间传说和地方集体仪式，乡村女性这一边缘身份下被污名化的欲望与表达的失语，都吸引着陈俐在现代化语境里反复咀嚼、思考，并不可自拔地让这段模糊的记忆在祛魅和复魅之间左右摇摆。童年使用凤仙花染指甲的经历，成为了艺术家叙事的出发点。

在陈俐的作品中，矿物颜料绘制的凤仙花描摹出女性的欲念与幻想，柔和但爽利的笔触、甜美的色块和妖娆妩媚的花型为画面增添了一丝捉摸不定的神秘主义色彩。神龛、田螺、蜡烛、羽毛，仪式道具般的装置完美隐喻了被迫神圣化的他者的自我献祭过程——正如田螺姑娘的故事里，任劳任怨、无私无欲、完全利他的纯洁圣女，最终作为符号被捧上神坛供奉；而全体女性也在这种神化下沉默，逐渐成为符号的养分。

看见凤仙花是一种还俗行为。作品里的凤仙花带着斑驳的涩味，就像白玉里的瑕疵，丝绸上的霉斑，给人以微妙的不适感，却让它显得更加婉转。画面中溢出的“妖性”，暗示着对清规戒律的委婉拒绝，暧昧的欲念纠缠蔓延，最终它呼唤神坛上的女人走出那一步——还俗，回归属于个人的真实，重返日常生活，在残酷而美丽的酒神精神中获得悲剧性的陶醉。

englishContext: Big Names / 名利场 was a co-curated opening project for Privileged Gallery / 七日画廊's inaugural exhibition and collector-party series, presented within ART NOVA 100 / 100青年艺术季 at Guardian Art Center, Beijing in April 2024. Co-curated by Ting Deng / 邓婷 and Lianyi Wang / 王莲仪, the project took one of the most ordinary rituals of an art opening, adding people on WeChat, and made it bluntly operational. Visitors could make a RMB 9.9 donation and draw a blind-box WeChat QR-code sticker, advertised as a chance to collect contacts from inside the art world.
fullTextZh:
白立方，聚光灯，手拿Champagne杯莫停。

又一个展览开幕了。

你谈德勒兹，我说齐泽克，拉康和柏格森的门生对上鲍曼和斯蒂格勒的研究者，觥筹交错间冒出一群旁听的尼采海德格尔摩拳擦掌加入对话，在艺术殿堂与偶遇的同行进行友好交流，你来我往几个回合，基本确认对方的圈内人身份，大家掏出手机开启了开幕时最拨动人心弦的环节——加微信。

其实看不看展览不重要，作品到底啥意思也不重要。既然大家都是来加微信的咱们就简化下这个流程，单刀直入真诚点。本次开幕，我们就只做一件事——加微信。

什么？你说我败坏艺术圈风气？马桶都能成艺术了，微信二维码怎么就不是作品了？如此具有符号性图像性现代科技大他者的载体，熟读索绪尔潘诺夫斯基拉康马克思的在座诸位谁还不能写一篇小作文？

当然，单纯加微信又显得不够风雅，为了给大家平淡的生活增加一点捉摸不定的趣味，我们决定采用盲盒的形式。9块9一次，可以抽取圈内人微信二维码贴纸。放心，我们已经帮您验证过了，保证箱子里的都是「圈内人」，至少包含美术馆馆长、画廊主、策展人、大藏家、大艺术家的联系方式，最差也是个美院毕业的底层艺术家或边缘策展人。

本次收费视为捐赠，您当然可以无限捐赠，把这一箱微信全加了，让自己不虚此行。全部捐赠将进入NMNA Foundation「无金钱不艺术」基金会，并进行公示。

一分人脉一份机缘，祝您成功！

NMNA Foundation

title: The Eight Precepts
projectContext: Entrance Space's opening exhibition, bringing together twelve artists in a group project structured around precepts, constraints and the public behaviours produced by rules.
projectContextZh: 入口空间的开幕展，汇集十二位艺术家，以戒律、限制及规则所生产的公共行为作为项目结构。
systemBehaviour: rules became visible by asking to be obeyed
systemBehaviourZh: 规则通过要求服从而变得可见
summaryEn: Entrance Space's opening group exhibition, bringing together twelve artists around precepts, constraints and the public behaviours produced by rules.
summaryZh: 《八戒》作为入口空间的开幕展，汇集十二位艺术家，并以戒律、限制及规则所生产的公共行为作为展览结构。
englishContext:
The Eight Precepts opened Entrance Space in Zhengzhou in July 2023. Bringing together twelve artists, the group exhibition used the idea of a precept as both theme and working structure: a rule is never merely written down, but becomes visible through the behaviours, compromises and evasions it produces.

The project established an early point in Entrance Space's programme and later formed a deliberate bookend with From Zero, the venue's final exhibition before moving to a new space.
fullTextZh:
《八戒》于2023年7月作为入口空间的开幕展举办，汇集十二位艺术家。展览将“戒”同时作为主题与工作结构：规则并不只存在于文字中，而是在服从、协商与规避它的行为里显形。

这个项目构成了入口空间项目线索的起点；两年后，空间搬迁前的最后一场展览《从零开始》与它形成首尾呼应，再次追问艺术如何借规则、语言与授权成立。

imageCreditZh: 图片由画廊与艺术家工作室提供。

title: The Relics
venue: SAMAR Art Black Box / SAMAR艺术黑匣子
projectContext: A solo exhibition of Ash Zing's ongoing project The Relics, begun in 2020. The artist photographs every owned object using the lighting and frontal format of an identification portrait.
projectContextZh: Ash Zing自2020年开始持续拍摄自己拥有的每一件物品，并以证件照式的正面构图和灯光将它们纳入同一套观看规则。
format: Solo exhibition; ongoing photographic inventory and object archive
formatZh: 个展；持续进行的摄影清单与物品档案
operativeMedium: serial identification-style photography of every object owned by the artist
operativeMediumZh: 以证件照式摄影持续记录艺术家拥有的每一件物品
publicInterface: solo exhibition and expanding photographic inventory
publicInterfaceZh: 个展与持续扩张的摄影清单
researchFields: object biography and equality of scale
systemBehaviour: each possession is photographed through the same portrait protocol, making inexpensive, damaged, useful and sentimental objects formally equal while the archive continues to grow
systemBehaviourZh: 每件物品都经过同一套肖像协议，廉价、破损、实用或承载情感的物品在形式上暂时平等，而档案仍继续生长
summaryEn: A solo exhibition examining how a life is composed through the objects a person leaves behind and the relationships carried by those objects.
summaryZh: 《The Relics》始于2020年。Ash Zing以证件照式的正面构图和灯光，逐件拍摄自己拥有的物品。统一的画幅暂时抹平了大小、价格、新旧与用途的差异，让物获得被凝视和记录的“尊严”；这份持续扩张的清单也反过来追问，一个人不在之后，所有物能否讲述其非视觉的面貌。
fullTextZh:
The Relics是艺术家Ash Zing的个人项目，所呈现的是一件“为生活而艺术”（Art For Life's Sake）的作品。“为生活而艺术”不是一个像“为艺术而艺术”（Art For Art's Sake）那样概念清晰的艺术史术语，而是有关我们对生活和艺术的认知，用艺术的视角审视生活，亦或是从生活中思考艺术的本质。

这件作品看起来普通到有些乏味，平平无奇的概念让它在其他炫酷的装置面前显得毫不起眼。因为太过简单，还很容易被模仿，甚至时常会让人产生这样的疑问：“如果这也算艺术的话，我的生活也充满了艺术，当艺术家就这么简单吗？”

不然呢？自从马塞尔·杜尚把小便池放进了美术馆，艺术本身就已经从复杂而抽象的视觉语言中抽离了，当然也可以从艰深的概念中抽离出来，就像The Relics这件作品的表达那样直白，所见即所得——尊重身边的物，爱具体的人。

说起来，Ash大概完全没有所谓“深爱艺术”的想法，他之所以会当艺术家，只是为了要搞懂“什么是艺术”，他深爱的只有生活。这世界上有很多哲学家和艺术家只爱抽象的人和生活的意义，却只让自己更深地陷入了虚无主义的窠臼。我无意以标准的格式为这个项目写什么前言，这本就是个懒散而自在的项目。人总是要死的，我们能留下的有什么呢？也许只有那些我们不曾真正拥有的“所有物”，是它们“构成”了完整而具体的我们。
collaborators: Weiyang Jiang / 姜未央, poster design
institutions: SAMAR Art Black Box / SAMAR艺术黑匣子

title: Tech-No-Logic
projectContext: A solo exhibition by Han Xia at 33ml Off-space, Shanghai, examining technology, logic, misrecognition and cultural imagination through installation.
projectContextZh: 韩夏在上海33ml Off-space的个展，以装置讨论技术、逻辑、误认与文化想象。
systemBehaviour: the machine behaved logically enough to become suspicious
systemBehaviourZh: 机器表现得足够符合逻辑，以至于开始显得可疑
summaryEn: Han Xia's solo exhibition at 33ml Off-space, examining technology, logic, misrecognition and cultural imagination through installation.
summaryZh: 韩夏在33ml Off-space的个展，以装置讨论技术、逻辑、误认与文化想象；机器越显得自洽，问题也越可疑。
englishContext:
Tech-No-Logic was Han Xia's solo exhibition at 33ml Off-space in Shanghai, presented from May to June 2023. The project approached technology less as a neutral tool than as a cultural system whose apparent logic can conceal projection, error and misrecognition.

Through installation and a deliberately unstable visual vocabulary, the exhibition asked how technological images acquire authority—and what becomes visible when a system behaves logically enough to become suspicious.
fullTextZh:
《技术没逻辑》是韩夏于2023年在上海33ml Off-space举办的个展。项目没有把技术当作中性的工具，而是将它视作一套由文化想象、投射、误认与权威共同构成的系统。

展览通过装置及刻意保持不稳定的视觉语汇，追问技术图像如何获得可信度。当一台机器表现得足够符合逻辑，它也开始显得可疑；作品由此把注意力从“技术能做什么”转向“我们为什么愿意相信它”。
imageCredit: Images courtesy of the gallery and the artist’s studio.
imageCreditZh: 图片由画廊与艺术家工作室提供。

title: Home, Sweet Home
projectContext: A constructed domestic installation presented through a deliberately withheld fictional premise. The advance text described an artist reconstructing a female neighbour's life from discarded delivery boxes; the project revealed at the opening that the ‘strange woman’ was fictional.
projectContextZh: 一个以刻意隐瞒的虚构前提展开的家居装置。展览预告描述艺术家依据女邻居丢弃的快递箱重构其生活，并在开幕时揭示“陌生女人”完全是虚构的。
format: Conceptual installation; constructed domestic environment; fictional narrative
formatZh: 观念装置；建构的家居环境；虚构叙事
operativeMedium: a staged domestic room, discarded-delivery-box narrative, fictional neighbour and timed public reveal
operativeMediumZh: 被布置的家居房间、弃置快递箱叙事、虚构邻居与定时揭晓
publicInterface: exhibition installation, opening reveal, livestream and subsequent online controversy
publicInterfaceZh: 展览装置、开幕揭晓、直播与后续网络争议
systemBehaviour: the project withholds its fictional premise long enough for the public to reproduce the same acts of inference, surveillance and imitation that the installation describes
systemBehaviourZh: 项目暂时隐瞒其虚构前提，让公众实际复制装置所描述的推断、窥视与模仿行为
summaryEn: A constructed domestic installation that used a fictional female neighbour and a timed public reveal to examine looking, privacy, consent and judgement from fragments.
summaryZh: 《一个陌生女人的房间》以一名男性艺术家依据女邻居弃置的快递箱、重构其生活为预告叙事，并在开幕时揭示这位“陌生女人”完全是虚构的。房间、便签、家居物品和反复出现的《猫和老鼠》线索共同构成一个有意露出破绽的舞台；公众围绕偷窥、隐私和同意展开的争议，则成为作品讨论权力、性别与碎片化判断的第二层现场。
englishContext:
J2 He moved into a commercial and residential building in early 2021. The exhibition's advance narrative claimed that he had recorded a female neighbour's purchases from delivery boxes left outside her room, then re-purchased the same objects to reconstruct her life after she moved away. At the opening, the project revealed that the ‘strange woman’ had never existed.

The staged room, handwritten notes, domestic objects, Tom and Jerry clues and an intentionally clumsy robotic vacuum made the installation's fiction visible without announcing it in advance. The public controversy surrounding voyeurism, privacy and consent became a second site of the work, reproducing the same acts of inference and imitation that the installation described.
fullTextZh:
何佶佴于2021年年初搬进了一栋商住两用楼，入住后发现他的女邻居有一个习惯——她总是把她拆完的快递盒堆在房门口。久而久之何佶佴对她的快递和生活产生了兴趣，于是他根据她丢弃的快递盒上的信息，记录下了邻居每一次网购的东西。如今这位女邻居已经搬走，何佶佴重新购买了那些她曾经买过的东西，并试图用这些碎片信息去复原她曾经的生活。

这是一次恶劣的窥探，也是一次拙劣的模仿，然而正是恶劣的窥探和拙劣的模仿，才组成了我们所谓的人际关系和整个世界。在当下权力结构的隐喻里，那个陌生女人成了一种处境，困住了我们每一个人。

展览开幕当天公开了虚构设定：这个陌生女人并不存在。拆过的快递箱、剧场式家居摆设、反复出现的《猫和老鼠》线索、漏洞百出的便利贴和横冲直撞的扫地机器人，都在暗示空间的虚构属性。展览尚未揭晓时激起的讨论，也让创作伦理、艺术道德、法律边界以及公众如何依据碎片信息判断他人的问题一并浮出水面。

title: Woods and Spring in the Moonlight
projectContext: A group exhibition using the traditional ideas of 月下, 林泉 and 澄怀卧游 to connect contemporary artworks with the cultural geography of Dunhuang.
projectContextZh: 一个以“月下”“林泉”和“澄怀卧游”的传统观念为线索，将当代作品与敦煌文化地理连接起来的群展。
artists: Hao Jingfang & Wang Lingjie / 郝经芳 & 王令杰
collaborators: Chen Zeyi / 陈则以, exhibition executive
formatZh: 群展；回应酒店建筑空间的展览
operativeMedium: a hotel exhibition route that treats artworks and architectural space as a contemporary form of 卧游
operativeMediumZh: 把作品与酒店建筑空间作为当代“卧游”路径
publicInterface: group exhibition across Jangala Dunhuang's interior spaces
publicInterfaceZh: 分布于敦煌碧玥酒店室内空间的群展
systemBehaviour: the exhibition turns a contemporary hotel interior into a route through images of sand, mountains, woods and water, allowing place and artwork to carry each other's memory
systemBehaviourZh: 展览将当代酒店内部变成一条穿过沙、山、林、湖图像的路线，让地点与作品彼此携带对方的记忆
summaryEn: A site-responsive group exhibition connecting contemporary art with Dunhuang's cultural geography through the literati idea of travelling through a landscape without leaving the room.
summaryZh: 《月下林泉》以“月下”的内观意象和郭熙《林泉高致》中的文人传统为起点，把敦煌的时间线索扩展为空间经验。七组当代艺术家的作品以沙、山、林、湖等自然意象进入碧玥酒店的建筑空间，让观看成为一种当代“卧游”。
fullTextZh:
“月下”在传统中国文化中天然具有自省、冥想、内观的色彩，而“林泉”不仅指艺术品所呈现的沙、山、林、湖等自然风貌，也出自北宋画家郭熙的《林泉高致》一书。书中升华了文人墨客“澄怀卧游”的概念，将一种通过欣赏山水画而代替欣赏自然山水的文人思想，发展到了写意的创作境界。而在充满不确定性的当下，这种哲思也引导我们将艺术空间和作品本身视为可以“畅游”的对象。

在东方文化中，月亮有空灵、孤独的意象，月光下似乎天然具有自省、冥想、内观的色彩。明月当空，不仅映照着离别与相思，也暗藏时间的流逝。如果“时间”是讲述敦煌艺术故事的一个线索，当我们回溯历史上的敦煌，看它从春秋时的一座小城历经千年更迭生长成河西走廊边陲重镇，会发现它的艺术离不开更大的人文空间和自然空间。于是，“空间”提供了敦煌叙事的另一个线索。

与线性的时间不同，感知空间的工具可以更加多维：它是身体，是眼睛，是味道，进而是记忆。当我们身处荒野绿洲，七组当代艺术家的作品以沙、山、林、湖等自然意象进入碧玥酒店的建筑空间，让观看成为一种当代“卧游”，并由身体、视觉、气味与记忆重新连接敦煌的人文空间和自然空间。

在这里，我们将艺术空间和艺术本身视为“卧游”的对象，在当代语境里找寻隐含在不同媒介中的文人传统。这些艺术作品反复论及时间、空间与记忆的关系。跟日月山河相比，人生匆忙而短暂，但大漠深处的敦煌从来不是一座孤城。连接彼此的不只是敦煌这个名字，更是背后绵延不绝的精神传承。

title: Cosmicus Ephemeroptera
projectContext: An online group exhibition presented with Space Art Gallery and the Taijing-1 01 Satellite, combining virtual exhibition space, a livestream opening and satellite-linked technological imagination.
projectContextZh: 与Space Art Gallery及泰景一号01星合作的线上群展，将虚拟展览空间、直播开幕与卫星关联的技术想象结合起来。
format: Online group exhibition and satellite-linked project
formatZh: 线上群展与卫星关联项目
publicInterface: online exhibition, livestream opening and satellite-linked platform
publicInterfaceZh: 线上展览、直播开幕与卫星关联平台
systemBehaviour: classification briefly mistook itself for a universe
systemBehaviourZh: 分类短暂地误以为自己就是一个宇宙
summaryEn: An online group exhibition connecting a virtual exhibition space, livestream opening and the technological imagination of the Taijing-1 01 Satellite.
summaryZh: 一场连接虚拟展览空间、直播开幕与泰景一号01星技术想象的线上群展，在分类学、宇宙尺度与策展叙事之间建立临时系统。
englishContext:
Cosmicus Ephemeroptera was an online group exhibition presented with Space Art Gallery and the Taijing-1 01 Satellite in June 2022. Its public form combined a virtual exhibition, livestream opening and a satellite-linked platform.

The project brought classification, cosmology and technological imagination into the same speculative structure. Rather than treating outer space as a neutral backdrop, it used the satellite as both infrastructure and cultural image: a system for organising how a brief human presence might be seen at another scale.
fullTextZh:
《宇宙蜉蝣》于2022年6月以线上群展的形式呈现，由Space Art Gallery、泰景一号01星与波眼艺术共同参与。项目的公共界面包括虚拟展览空间、直播开幕以及与卫星关联的平台。

展览把分类学、宇宙尺度与技术想象放进同一个临时结构中。卫星在这里既是基础设施，也是文化图像：它改变观看的尺度，也把短暂的人类经验重新组织为一种可被命名、传输和想象的宇宙档案。

title: Walking Art Season
venue: Henan Culture Center / 河南省文化馆
projectContext: A ten-day public-art programme across the Henan Culture Center, People's Park and surrounding city streets in Zhengzhou.
projectContextZh: 一个横跨河南省文化馆、人民公园及郑州城市街区的十日公共艺术项目。
format: Series of public activities: exhibition, talks, performances, indoor market and outdoor market
formatZh: 系列公共活动：展览、讲座、表演、室内市集与户外市集
systemBehaviour: the route edited the audience in real time
summaryEn: A ten-day public-art programme in Zhengzhou combining an exhibition, talks, performances and indoor and outdoor markets across the Henan Culture Center and People's Park.
summaryZh: 一个在郑州展开的十日公共艺术项目，将展览、讲座、表演、室内市集与户外夜市分布在河南省文化馆、人民公园及城市街区。
englishContext:
Walking Art Season was a ten-day public-art programme in Zhengzhou, co-curated by Ting Deng and Lianyi Wang. Exhibition, talks, performances and indoor and outdoor markets were distributed across the Henan Culture Center, People's Park and the surrounding city streets.

The programme treated walking not only as movement between events but as a curatorial method. The route connected different institutions, public spaces and audiences, allowing the city itself to edit the order in which the project was encountered.
fullTextZh:
《行走艺术季》于2024年5月至6月在郑州展开，由邓婷与王莲仪联合策展。十日项目将展览、讲座、表演、室内市集与户外夜市分布在河南省文化馆、人民公园及周边城市街区。

“行走”在这里不只是不同活动之间的移动方式，也是一种策展方法。路线连接了机构空间、公共场所与不同观众，让城市本身参与编辑项目被看见的顺序。

summaryEn: A two-day board-game project by J2 He that turned the pursuit of contemporary-art success into cards, rankings, alliances and procedural absurdity.
summaryZh: 何佶佴以桌游规则、行动卡、作品卡与排名机制，把“如何成为成功的当代艺术家”改写成一场可以组局、竞争和互相拆台的公共活动。
englishContext:
A Guide to Success in Contemporary Art was a two-day participatory project by J2 He at LPS Local Landscape in Guangzhou. Using an instruction manual, action cards, work cards and multiplayer rules, it translated the pursuit of artistic success into a playable system of rankings, alliances and procedural absurdity.

Players did not simply discuss the art world from outside it. They had to operate inside a compressed model of its incentives, learning how status is accumulated, how alliances alter outcomes and why success so often requests documentation before appearing.
fullTextZh:
《成功当代艺术家指南》是何佶佴于2023年在广州LPS Local Landscape开展的两日参与式项目。说明书、行动卡、作品卡与多人规则，将追逐当代艺术成功的过程压缩成一套可以被实际运行的排名、结盟与竞争系统。

参与者并非站在游戏外谈论艺术世界，而是必须进入它的激励机制：积累地位、改变关系、使用规则，并看着荒诞结果以合乎程序的方式出现。项目用桌游的轻松外壳，让“成功”显露为一套依赖证明、协商与运气的制度行为。
collaborators: Buoyant Art / 波眼艺术, exhibition collaboration

title: Who is Inside?
projectContext: Yanfei Chen's first solo exhibition, presenting oil paintings, mixed-media works and bilingual poems made in 2018 and 2019. Enclosed interiors populated by empty chairs, mattresses, stones, a crow and displaced furniture treat the room as both a physical boundary and a model of inner life.
projectContextZh: 陈燕菲的首次个展，呈现其2018至2019年创作的油画、综合材料作品与双语诗歌。封闭室内、空椅、床垫、石头、乌鸦与错位家具，让房间同时成为物理边界与内在生活的模型。
format: Solo exhibition; oil painting, mixed media, poetry and spatial installation
formatZh: 个展；油画、综合材料、诗歌与空间装置
operativeMedium: oil painting, mixed-media objects, poems and staged relations between depicted rooms and physical furniture
operativeMediumZh: 油画、综合材料物件、诗歌与图像房间和实体家具之间的空间关系
publicInterface: solo exhibition, printed catalogue, wall labels and a chair positioned in front of a painting
publicInterfaceZh: 个展、印刷画册、墙面标签与一把面对画作放置的椅子
systemBehaviour: familiar rooms lose their ordinary function as stones, crows, mattresses and misplaced furniture turn each interior into a psychological diagram; a physical chair draws the viewer into the same spatial logic
systemBehaviourZh: 石头、乌鸦、床垫和错位家具使熟悉的房间失去日常功能，转而成为心理图表；一把实体椅子又把观众带入同一套空间逻辑
summaryEn: Yanfei Chen's first solo exhibition used enclosed interiors, displaced objects, mixed-media works and bilingual poems to treat the room as both a physical boundary and a structure of memory.
summaryZh: 陈燕菲的首次个展《在里面的人》以封闭室内、错位物件、综合材料和双语诗歌构成一组心理空间。空椅、床垫、石头、乌鸦和被放置在异常位置的家具，让“里面”同时指向可进入的房间与难以确认的内在自我。
englishContext:
Who is Inside? was Yanfei Chen's first solo exhibition, presented at The Old Street Gallery in London from 4 to 10 October 2019 and co-curated by Lianyi Wang and Manqiao Fang. Paintings, mixed-media works and poems built a sequence of sealed interiors: empty corridors, a mattress edged by a crow, a dining table set with a stone, a sofa held inside a taped boundary, and chairs that appear to wait for occupants who never arrive.

The title treats ‘inside’ as both location and condition. Chen's rooms borrow from Gaston Bachelard's writing on domestic space as a structure of consciousness, while thick paint, covered surfaces and displaced objects make the rooms behave like memory: familiar enough to enter, unstable enough to resist a fixed address. In one installation, a chair facing a painting extends the depicted interior into the gallery and gives the viewer an awkward place within it.
